not_tracked: Mid-cap assets: no tracked mid-cap asset universe (this platform tracks BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP only — see cfi.market.universe.ASSET_SYMBOLS).
DeFi-sector assets: no tracked DeFi-token universe.
AI-related assets: no tracked AI-token universe.

Meme assets: no price, market-cap or flow data is ingested for meme coins. The 'meme_assets' node uses retail's meme-coin trending-mention count as a retail-ATTENTION proxy only — never a capital-flow or market-share measure, and excluded from the pairwise rotation matrix.
'Large Caps' here means only this platform's own 4-asset universe (BTC+ETH+SOL+XRP), not a broad market large-cap index — a scope decision, not a claim that no other large-cap assets exist.

The residual share of the genuine global crypto TOTAL market cap not held by BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP (i.e. everything the global TOTAL includes but this platform does not individually track) cannot be decomposed into mid-cap / DeFi / AI / meme sub-shares with this platform's current data — it is reported once as an informational 'untracked_share_pct' figure, never split further.
Stablecoin exchange balances and exchange flows are not tracked (cfi.liquidity.universe's own NOT_TRACKED) — only aggregate circulating supply.
